summary: Iter 10 Daily-Reports Phase 2 verification: 18/18 backend tests PASS (test_iteration10.py) covering idempotent create, PATCH+lock-on-submit, weather-autofill (KCMO geocoded successfully), presence CRUD, unplanned-activity (AF-prefix + requires_pm_review + grid injection), delay/safety/qc/rfi/photo daily_report_id linkage, /context bundle (all 13 keys), strict-no-markdown copilot reply, copilot DR-only tools (record_presence, mark_activity_status, create_unplanned_activity), approve flow (admin/pm only, requires submitted, locks PATCH). Frontend /daily-reports renders cleanly: list with date/status/submitted columns, header KPIs, weather-autofill button works, crew presence add works (3 rows), activity grid with SOD/EOD/Δ variance, status select, AF-prefixed unplanned rows with FIELD badge, renovation panel rendered for renovation project, delays/safety inline panels show created rows, dr-submit button visible. No critical UI bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Pre-existing from iter 8 — emitted on /daily-reports load too because the Tenant/Project switcher uses native <select>. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: daily_reports_router.py: weather_autofill correctly enforces lock on submitted DR (409) and 422 when geocoding fails — clean error UX. Tested live: KCMO geocoded successfully and returned weather_temp_high_f, weather_conditions, weather_fetched_at on the returned DR.
create_or_get_daily_report is idempotent — second POST for same project+date returns the existing DR id (verified).
PATCH /daily-reports/{id} correctly returns 409 once status=submitted (verified end-to-end via approve flow test).

create_unplanned_activity computes next AF#### code by scanning the last 50 task activity_codes per project and incrementing the highest trailing integer — works but assumes activity_codes are dense numerically; if a project has a hand-typed code like 'X-99' it could collide. Acceptable for current scope.

/context bundle: single round-trip with 13 keys (report, project, grid, presence, photos, voice_annotations, delays, safety_events, qc_issues, rfis, deliveries, audit_log, user_labels). Audit log query OR-clause uses {'_unused': True} when presence is empty — works but ugly; consider conditional query construction.
Copilot strict-no-markdown verified: tested response contained zero of *, #, `, |.

Copilot DR-tools all return the standardized envelope ({created|updated|deleted: ...}) — verified record_presence, create_unplanned_activity, mark_activity_status all returned correct shape and persisted correctly.
approve_daily_report enforces role admin/pm only — admin@iceops.com (admin role) approved successfully. Returns 409 if status != submitted.
Delay/SafetyEvent/QcIssue/Rfi all accept daily_report_id and the value flows to /context filtering correctly — confirmed for all 4 entities + photos via multipart upload.

Frontend DailyReports.jsx (884 lines) is on the larger side — could be split into sub-components (header, weather, presence-table, activity-grid, event-panels, renovation, audit) for maintainability, but currently functional and well covered by data-testid.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 2 scope. Initial 4 linkage test failures were on my side (used wrong field names — delay_date/event_date/issue_date/category instead of canonical date/event_type/reason_category, and 'low' severity instead of 'minor'). Once test payloads matched DelayCreate/SafetyEventCreate/QcIssueCreate/RfiCreate models, all linkages worked end-to-end including /context filtering.
